report.summary: Alex’s strongest keep themes are the way they listen in one-to-one conversations, retain context, and follow up, and the way they step in to support work when people are blocked or issues arise. These behaviours help build trust and can save the team time. The main change theme is delivery timeline communication: expectations need clearer dates or confidence ranges, and internal updates need to come sooner when plans change.
